sets.title: Authorization decision: direct vs event-dispatch vs scattered-concerns expression
sets.description: The same resource-authorization decision in three semantically equivalent forms: carrier A uses the pristine guard-clause boolean-return form, carrier B uses an event-dispatch style with conceptual before/after authorize events (sem_event variant), and carrier C uses a scattered-concerns style with descriptive variable names indicating different conceptual classes (sem_scatter variant). All three compute behaviorally identical results. No two carriers share a token run long enough for token/line tools to pair them, so only semantic detection is expected to recover the cluster.
sets.notes: Set 001 of 5. SEM-06 variant (sem_event) uses conceptual event dispatch pattern. SEM-08 variant (sem_scatter) expresses logic with scattered-concerns variable naming. Behavioral equivalence enforced by gen/seeds/access_guard/equivalence_test.php.

distractors.reason: near-miss: same auth vocabulary (user/resource/roles/grants/status) but computes a numeric trust score, not a boolean decision
